    • getToPlay

      public int getToPlay(Player p)
      Returns the amount a specific player still needs to contribute to match the highest bet in this pot. Adds the player to this pot if they are not already registered.
      Parameters:
      p - the Player whose remaining contribution is calculated
      Returns:
      the positive difference between the highest investment per player and what p has invested

    • setToPlay

      public void setToPlay(int toPlay)
      Sets the amount-to-play for this pot (used during blind initialisation and pot adjustments).
      Parameters:
      toPlay - the new amount every player must match

    • getInvestmentPP

      public int getInvestmentPP()
      Returns the current maximum chips any single player has invested in this pot.

      the investment-per-player ceiling

    • setInvestmentPP

      public void setInvestmentPP(int investmentPP)
      Manually overrides the investment-per-player value (used during side-pot adjustments).
      Parameters:
      investmentPP - the new per-player investment ceiling

    • stepPotPriority

      public void stepPotPriority(int step)
      Increments this pot's priority value by the given step amount. Higher priority means the pot was created later (side pot ordering).
      Parameters:
      step - the integer amount to add to the current priority

    • getPotPriority

      public int getPotPriority()
      Returns the priority index of this pot. Lower values are processed first; side pots have higher values.
      Returns:
      the pot priority integer

    • setPotPriority

      public void setPotPriority(int potPriority)
      Sets the priority index of this pot.
      Parameters:
      potPriority - the new priority value

      public int getPotSize()
      Returns the total number of chips currently in this pot.
      Returns:
      the pot size in chips

    • setPotSize

      public void setPotSize(int potSize)
      Directly overrides the total size of this pot.
      Parameters:
      potSize - the new pot value in chips

    • addToPotSize

      public void addToPotSize(int amount)
      Increases the pot size by the given amount.
      Parameters:
      amount - the positive number of chips to add

    • getIsOpen

      public boolean getIsOpen()
      Returns whether this pot is still open for betting.
      Returns:
      true if players can still bet into this pot; false if it is closed

    • setIsOpen

      public void setIsOpen(boolean status)
      Opens or closes this pot. Closing sets the pot priority to -1 to signal that it is no longer the active pot.
      Parameters:
      status - true to open the pot (accepting bets), false to close it

    • closePot

      public void closePot()
      Closes this pot and resets the amount-to-play to zero, preventing further bets.

      Parameters:
      player - the Player to register in the bet table

    • addPlayer2Table

      public void addPlayer2Table(Player player, int bet)
      Adds a player to the bet-tracking table with a specific existing contribution.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player to register
      bet - the amount already attributed to this player in the pot

    • getBetFromTable

      public int getBetFromTable(Player player)
      Returns the recorded bet contribution for a specific player from the bet table.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player whose contribution is looked up
      Returns:
      the integer chip amount this player has contributed to this pot

    • addBet

      public void addBet(Player player, int bet)
      Records a bet from the given player into this pot. Updates the bet table, fires the player's Player.placeBet(int, com.example.projectpoker.model.game.Pot) deduction, recalculates the investment-per-player, and updates the amount-to-play when a raise occurs.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player placing the bet
      bet - the number of chips being bet

    • initBlinds

      public void initBlinds(ArrayList<Player> players, ArrayList<Integer> turnOrder, int blindSize)
      Deducts blind amounts from the small-blind and big-blind players and adds them to this pot. Should be called exactly once per round, before any other bets.
      Parameters:
      players - the full list of players in turn order
      turnOrder - a list of seat indices where index 0 = small blind, index 1 = big blind
      blindSize - the base blind amount (small blind = 0.5×, big blind = 1×)

    • removeFolded

      public RoundStatus removeFolded(RoundStatus status)
      Removes all folded players from this pot's player list. If only one player remains after removal the round is cut short and SHOWDOWN is returned.
      Parameters:
      status - the current RoundStatus; END is passed through unchanged
      Returns:
      the next RoundStatus after removing folded players

    • showDown

      public int showDown(ArrayList<Card> communityCards)
      Evaluates all remaining hands at showdown, awards the pot to the winner(s), and marks winning players with the WINNER role.
      Parameters:
      communityCards - the five community cards on the board
      Returns:
      the number of winners who split the pot

    • adjustPot

      public void adjustPot(Pot sidePot)
      Migrates chips from this (higher-priority) pot into the given lower-priority side pot. Recalculates each player's investment records to reflect the new pot hierarchy.
      Parameters:
      sidePot - the lower-priority Pot that should receive a portion of this pot's chips; must have a priority strictly less than this pot's priority
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the adjustment would produce a negative pot size
